**Possible Operational Root Cause:**
> [Hypothesis - Operational] The high volume of duplicate charge complaints, primarily originating via the web channel, suggests a potential idempotency failure or timeout retry flaw in the Summit Path Payments gateway integration, leading to double-submission of transactions by customers.

**Recommended Engineering & Operations Actions:**
1. Review API gateway logs and payment transaction tables for Summit Path Payments to identify concurrent or identical transaction payloads sharing the same idempotency keys within short time windows.
2. Audit frontend web application submission buttons and event handlers to verify whether double-clicks or multiple POST requests are properly prevented during transaction processing.
3. Analyze backend payment processing timeouts and retry mechanisms to determine if dropped network packets between the client, web server, and payment processor trigger unintended duplicate settlements.
